entities.summary: Thomas Jefferson Page was a naval officer and explorer. He served first in the United States Navy and commanded an expedition which made the first detailed hydrological studies of the Río de la Plata basin in South America. At the outbreak of the American Civil War, he resigned to serve in the Confederate Army and later the Confederate States Navy. Late in the war, Page was captain of the ironclad CSS Stonewall.
